tools module¶

General file for useful methods from Computational Physics with Python from Eric Ayars, Caltech

tools.euler()¶

A routine that implements Euler’s method to find the new state of y

Parameters:
  • y (vector, current state) –
  • t (time) –
  • dt (time step) –
  • derivs (function that returns the derivatives of vector y, defines the system) –
Returns:

y_next
Return type:

vector, next state
tools.rk2()¶

Moves the value of ‘y’ forward by a step of size ‘dt’ using a second-order Runge-Kutta algorithm. Equivalent to finding the average of the slope at time t and at time (t+dt), and using the average slope to find the new value of y.

Parameters:
  • y (vector, current state) –
  • t (time) –
  • dt (time step) –
  • derivs (function that returns the derivatives of vector y, defines the system) –
Returns:

y_next
Return type:

vector, next state

  • y (vector, current state) –
  • t (time) –
  • dt (time step) –
  • derivs (function that returns the derivatives of vector y, defines the system) –
Returns:

y_next
